visualCharacteristics.purpose: intro text beside a table of dates (grant cycle deadlines)

contentPattern.structure: row 1: heading + text | optional caption. Rows 2+: table rows, the first being the header row (its first cell may be empty); first cell of each later row is the row label

reuseGuidance: Use for a short schedule or comparison table beside intro copy. For a full-width data table use table-product.
